mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair renal function and increase sildenafil accumulation, while both drugs cause vasodilation leading to additive hypotensive effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess renal function regularly, maintain electrolyte levels, consider dose reduction of sildenafil, and evaluate alternative antifungal agents if possible.
